messages:
alex: Spotted a persistent issue on the private-controlplane refactor. When we rehome the CP into a customer VPC, existing TCP sessions to the relay stay ESTABLISHED and keep forwarding to the old backend identity. The relay shows TLS up but backend auth fails -> 502 until idle timeout. Anyone seen this in prod/staging?

maria-l: yup, hit this in staging. Keepalives didn't close them. We need a graceful session handoff or agent-initiated teardown. Otherwise customers see opaque 5xxs.

kevin_g: after the route flip do clients reconnect to the new relay IP or keep sending to the old one?

alex: they keep the socket to the old IP. Relay tries to talk to CP but handshake fails because CP identity changed. Connection remains in limbo until idle timeout (~5m).

jess: options: (1) agent-initiated session close on detach, (2) route withdraw + infra RST, (3) aggressive idle TTL. (3) cheap but affects normal flows.

maria-l: I prefer (1). Agent already talks to CP; add signed "terminate_sessions" RPC during detach. Need replay protection and auth though.

kevin_g: agree. Use ed25519-signed payload with iat/exp and request_id. Agent validates then closes sockets mapped to session ids. Avoids global route churn.

alex: prototyped it. Edge cases: agent-unreachable -> stale sessions remain; need fallback. Also need mapping from CP session ids to agent socket fds.

jess: fallback is heavy: route withdraw may cause flaps for peered VPCs. For hosted/dedicated we can force infra-level RSTs. For private peering rely on agent or cert TTL.

maria-l: cert TTL approach is viable but triggers reconnection storms. Kevin, can you run a reconnection QPS spike test in staging?

kevin_g: will do and report P99s.

security: recommend ed25519, include nonce/request_id, rotate signer per-region, no symmetric keys over peering.

alex: I'll land a minimal signed terminate webhook prototype and return closed session ids for CP reconciliation. Will also add alert if >10 stale sessions linger 10m after detach.

jess: action items: alex prototype, kevin reconnection test, jess write runbook for route-withdraw fallback. SRE-bot: please file a ticket.
sre-bot: Created INFRA-1234 assigned to @alex P2 ETA 3d.

alex: will post links and test plan when ready. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
